name: Sagar Samman Award- Recognition of Outstanding Maritime Training Institutes
teName: సాగర్ సమ్మాన్ అవార్డు-అత్యుత్తమ సముద్ర శిక్షణ సంస్థలకు గుర్తింపు
teBrief: అగ్రశ్రేణి సముద్ర సంస్థలకు ర్యాంకింగ్స్ మరియు గుర్తింపును అందించడం ద్వారా సముద్ర విద్య మరియు శిక్షణలో శ్రేష్ఠతను గుర్తించడం ఈ పథకం లక్ష్యం.
brief: The scheme aims to recognize excellence in maritime education and training by providing rankings and recognition to top maritime institutes.
briefFull: The scheme aims to recognize excellence in maritime education and training by providing rankings and recognition to top maritime institutes.
details: The "Sagar Samman Award- Recognition of Outstanding Maritime Training Institutes" scheme has been launched by the Directorate General of Shipping, Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, Government of India. The scheme aims to recognize exceptional contributions made by maritime training institutes in advancing maritime education, skill development, and human resource capacity in the maritime sector.
benefits:
- Formal national-level recognition to top 3 institutes in each category.
- Inter-se ranking to determine 1st, 2nd, and 3rd positions.
- Public acknowledgment during National Maritime Day celebrations.
- Enhanced institutional reputation and credibility.
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a Directorate General of Shipping (DGS) approved maritime training institute.
1. The applicant should have participated in the Comprehensive Inspection Programme (CIP).
1. The applicant should have demonstrated consistent and high performance in training quality and outcomes.
1. The applicant should fall under one of the following categories:

- Pre-sea training institutes for Officer Cadets (Nautical & Engineering);
- Pre-sea training institutes for Rating Trainees;
- Post-sea training institutes conducting Competency Courses.
howToApply:
[Online]
**Step 01:** Visit the National Awards Portal: [https://www.awards.gov.in](https://awards.gov.in/)
**Step 02:** Register/Login using the official credentials of the recommending authority
**Step 03:** Fill in the nomination form with complete details
**Step 04:** Upload required documents, including citation and verification certificate
documentsRequired:
- Directorate General Of Shipping Approval Certificate
- Comprehensive Inspection Programme (CIP) Evaluation Report
- Institutional Performance Records
- Course Accreditation Documents
- Details Of Training Infrastructure And Facilities
- Faculty And Training Staff Details
- Student Placement And Employment Records

- శిక్షణ మౌలిక సదుపాయాలు మరియు సౌకర్యాల వివరాలు
- అధ్యాపకులు మరియు శిక్షణ సిబ్బంది వివరాలు

faqs.q: Who are eligible for this recognition?
faqs.a: Only Directorate General of Shipping approved maritime training institutes are eligible.

faqs.q: How many institutes are recognized each year?
faqs.a: Top 3 institutes in each category are recognized annually.
faqs.qTe: ప్రతి సంవత్సరం ఎన్ని సంస్థలకు గుర్తింపు ఉంది?

faqs.q: What are the categories under this recognition?
faqs.a: Categories include Officer Cadet training, Rating training, and Competency courses.
faqs.qTe: ఈ గుర్తింపు క్రింద ఉన్న వర్గాలు ఏమిటి?

faqs.q: What is the basis of selection?
faqs.a: Selection is based on performance in the Comprehensive Inspection Programme (CIP).

faqs.q: Is there any monetary reward under this scheme?
faqs.a: No, the scheme provides non-monetary recognition and ranking.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకం కింద ఏదైనా ద్రవ్య బహుమతి ఉందా?

faqs.a: The awards are announced on National Maritime Day.
Evaluation is conducted by recognized organizations and classification societies.

faqs.q: What is CIP in this scheme?
faqs.a: CIP stands for Comprehensive Inspection Programme used for performance evaluation.
No, only DGS-approved institutes are eligible.

faqs.q: What is the benefit of this recognition?
faqs.a: It enhances credibility, reputation, and quality standards of the institute.
faqs.qTe: ఈ గుర్తింపు వల్ల కలిగే ప్రయోజనం ఏమిటి?

faqs.a: No, it is valid for the award year and reviewed annually.

faqs.q: Does innovation play a role in selection?
faqs.a: Yes, innovative training methods and outcomes are considered.
The National Maritime Day Celebrations Committee finalizes the awardees.
